system: AI Operations Platform MVP (synthetic): multi-tenant AI CRM, messaging and scheduling SaaS with a tool-calling assistant
notes: Synthetic, pre-build design model. Mitigation statuses are mostly 'planned' because the MVP is not built. ASVS IDs were chosen by chapter/section title from the bundled 5.0.0 index and must be confirmed against the requirement text before use.

components.name: Tenant database (shared schema, tenant_id column, row-level security)

assets.name: End-customer contact details and message threads (personal data, per tenant)
Prompts and completions containing tenant data
Gateway API key (stored in secret manager; placeholder sk-FAKE-0000 in examples)

not_applicable.I: Webhook response is an empty 204; inbound content is stored, never echoed back to the sender

threats.title: Owner changes tenant_id in a request to read or book in another tenant

mitigations.description: Tenant derived from the authenticated session only; object-level authorization on every booking/contact endpoint

threats.title: Query missing the tenant filter returns another tenant's customers

mitigations.description: Repository-layer tenant filter plus database row-level security; static check SC003 in CI; isolation test suite AIOPS-VER-101
Rate limiting on login and MFA for owners

threats.title: Tampering with booking parameters in transit
Another tenant's data enters the model prompt context (shared cache or retrieval)

mitigations.description: Prompt built per request from one tenant's records; no cross-tenant retrieval index or cache in MVP; eval check AIOPS-VER-102

threats.title: Indirect prompt injection in an inbound customer email makes the assistant send messages or create bookings

mitigations.description: Inbound content labelled retrieved_content; side-effecting tools denied from untrusted provenance (tool policy)
Owner approval before every send/book; hidden markup stripped before the model reads content

threats.title: Session token disclosure via insecure cookie
API flooding by one tenant degrades booking for all tenants
Owner disputes having approved a message sent in their name

mitigations.description: Append-only activity log of draft, edit, approval and tool call with tenant, user and timestamp

threats.title: SQL injection through inbox search modifies tenant data

mitigations.description: Parameterised queries only; static check SC002 in CI

threats.title: Unbounded report query exhausts the shared database
threats.acceptance_rationale: Statement timeout of 5 s on reporting queries; revisit before 200 tenants

threats.title: Tenant message data retained or exposed by the LLM provider

mitigations.description: Data processing agreement, minimum-retention setting, send only the current thread

threats.title: LLM provider outage blocks owners from replying

mitigations.description: Inbox and manual reply work without the assistant (degraded mode)

threats.title: Completion altered in transit between platform and LLM provider

mitigations.description: TLS with certificate validation to the provider endpoint

threats.title: Forged inbound webhook injects fake customer messages

mitigations.description: Verify gateway signature and timestamp on every webhook

threats.title: Inbound webhook flood (spam) fills inboxes and drives LLM cost

mitigations.description: Per-source and per-tenant rate limits; drafts generated only when the owner opens a thread

threats.title: Assistant tool call exfiltrates customer data to a recipient outside the thread (AI tool misuse)

mitigations.description: Tool policy: recipients restricted to the thread's own customer; data egress to non-allowlisted domains denied; approval shows full arguments

threats.title: Message content altered between platform and gateway

mitigations.description: TLS to gateway; gateway key in secret manager, never in code

threats.title: SMS pumping or runaway tool loop sends large message volumes (cost and spam)

mitigations.description: Per-tenant daily send cap and circuit breaker on the send tools
